features: Added support for Broadcast R3D in RED Connect
Added support for Phantom Track in RED Connect
Added new Sensor Sync Shift interface
Added support for timecode triggered recording
Added Test Patterns to R3D Project Format

install.heading: IMPORTANT
items: Download the latest REDCINE-X PRO from https://www.reddigitalcinema.com/downloads

install.heading: UPGRADE V-RAPTOR FIRMWARE
items: Unzip and copy the upgrade folder, containing the upgrade.bin file, to the top level directory of the CFexpress card.
Power up the camera and insert a CFexpress card into the V-RAPTOR media slot.
Go to Menu > Maintenance > Upgrade and select Camera Upgrade.
The camera starts the upgrade process which will automatically restart the camera.
Go to Menu > System Settings > System Status > Camera Info to verify the firmware version after the camera boots.

install.heading: OPERATIONAL NOTES
items: RED CONNECT is a license enabled feature, for more info see https://support.reddigitalcinema.com/hc/en-us/articles/7391709361683
Some devices may experience intermittent connection issue over USB-C tethering.
Warning message will occur with unapproved media and batteries.
ST 2110 Return Feed is non-operational.

install.heading: IMPORTANT
items: Download the latest REDCINE-X PRO from https://www.reddigitalcinema.com/downloads

install.heading: UPGRADE KOMODO FIRMWARE
items: Copy upgrade.bin to a /upgrade directory on the CFast card.
Power up the camera and insert a CFAST card into the KOMODO media slot.
Go to Menu > Maintenance > Upgrade and select OK.
The camera initiates a 2 stage upgrade process which will automatically restart the camera.
After the camera restarts to complete the upgrade process, select RESTART once it appears.
Go to Menu > System Settings > System Status > Camera Info to verify the firmware version after the camera boots.
